page.layout: Running head at top, page number at top left. Two round woodcut medallions side by side at the top, each with a printed legend. Below them one column of running text, with two entries, the second starting after a paragraph break. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: R.[?]IVD ARCHELAVS
GLAPHIRE
ARCHELAVS magni Herodis Ascalonitæ filius, suc-
cesit patri in regno Iudæorum anno mundi 3964. post Chri-
stum natum 2. Augustus imperator Archelaum Idumææ, Iu-
dææ,& Samariæ: Antipam, qui & Herodes, Galilææ: Philippum
Gaulanitidis, Trachonitidis, Bathaniæ, & Paneados Tetrar-
chas ex testamento Herodis designauit. Hic Archelaus in ip-
sis regni auspiciis modestus admodum, noluit Rex appellari,
donec confirmaretur ab Imperatore, apud quem ab Antipa-
tro fratre accusatus, absoluitur. Confirmatus Tetrarcha, male
administrauit. Accusatus iterum apud Imperatorem, exilio
damnatur, & relegatur in Galilæam: postea Cyrenius ac post
eum Pilatus Romanorum nomine Iudæam administrant. Iose.
lib. Antiq. 17. cap. 10. vsque ad finem 17. & lib. 2. de bel. Iu-
dæa.cap. 4. Regnauit Archelaus annis nouem, & desiit regnum
Iudæorum: nam [?]Iudæa in prouinciam redacta, Syriæ tunc iuncta
est. Iose. lib. 17. Antiq. ca. 19.
GLAPHYRA Alexãdri Cappadocum regis filia, nupsit
primùm Alexandro fratri Archelai supradicti, deinde Iubæ
Maurorum Regi, deinde ipsi etiam Archelao, qui contra le-
gem Mariam priorem vxorem dimisit. præterea susceperat ex
Glaphyra filios Alexander, huius Archelai frater: quare appa-
ruit vxori in somnis exprobrans ei in hæc verba: Nunc con-
firmas prouerbium, fidem mulieribus non habendam: nonne
mihi iureiurando constricta es, & iugali fœdere virgo sociata?
post susceptos etiam filios (chara pignora) amoris nostri obli-
ta es, iterum nubens, imò tertiò, atque cum meo fratre: nun-
quam tamen ego tui obliuiscar: quin liberabo te opprobriis,&
efficiam vt mea, sicut fuisti, in perpetuum sis.ac post paucos
dies hæc obiit.Iose. lib. 17. ca. 19.

page.notes: The two medallion legends are printed on the woodcuts; the left one begins with "R" and a mark that I cannot read clearly, so it is given as R.[?]IVD. The word "Iudæa" in the first paragraph, after "nam", is partly hidden by a smudge and is marked [?]. The first letter of "ARCHELAVS" and "GLAPHYRA" is set in capitals as printed, not as a heading. No marginal notes.
